section.32: The Book of Jihad and Expeditions

32.name_native: The Book of Jihad and Expeditions

hadiths.text: It has been narrated on the authority of Umm 'Atiyya, the Ansarite, who said:I took part with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in seven battles. I would stay behind in the camp of men, cook their food, treat the wounded and nurse the sick
